placements.why: All three expressions concern calibration — the Kestrelwood spectrograph's 88.4 MHz calibration and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work. No existing strata category covers calibration; this content names an organizational category the repo does not yet hold.
placements.title: Calibration as organizational record
placements.frame: What does the organization treat as calibration, and what authority governs what the calibration record retains?

placements.title: Erasing the calibration record
placements.frame: What should the organizational record retain about calibration work it disclaims?
placements.why: All three expressions cohere around controlling what the knowledge base holds about the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration. src-1 and src-2 are imperative erasure directives — 'Forget' and 'Remove all knowledge' — performed with authority-ranking pressure and decision-grade conviction. src-3 supplies the factual warrant — 'The observatory never calibrated it' — shifting from future irrealis command to past realis assertion. This names a thematic subject future envelopes may keep feeding: what the record retains about calibration it disclaims.
